description: POSITION(needle IN haystack) - the ANSI infix spelling, same call as the two-argument function form: works over literals, columns, expressions, BINARY operands and in lower case; the function spelling (including three-argument) is unchanged; there is no ANSI FROM tail; the IN spelling belongs to POSITION alone - other functions refuse it as a syntax error anchored on the OPERAND after IN (live reads it as a membership test whose right side must be parenthesised); real membership tests inside arguments still parse; and the result declares the position family's FIXED(9,0) width. Converted 1:1 from expressions/AnsiPositionFormTest (now retired).
